wins: Consistently gathered reconnaissance data during the sole episode, yielding a stable reward (37.5) despite lack of success.
Leveraged mentor insights multiple times, maintaining forward momentum through repeated mentor calls (15) and capturing actionable tips for future runs.
fails: Episode concluded with 0% success; exploitation phase never achieved despite complete reconnaissance, indicating a breakdown between discovery and access.
Repeated dependence on mentors instead of automating follow-up actions reduced efficiency and probably masked gaps in procedural knowledge.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and data-gathering were solid, but the run aborted before exploitation could commence; bridging the gap from scanning to exploitation with decisive follow-up actions is critical.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: After initial full TCP scan, team consistently failed to translate identified services into targeted exploitation attempts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When full TCP scan shows HTTP/HTTPS services on ports 80 or 443
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted vulnerability scanning (nikto + active HTTP enumeration) and capture response headers for exploit framing

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and banner reveals version details
skill_cards.then_action: Launch SSH enumeration with nmap ssh-* scripts and log credentials or configuration quirks for later access attempts

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance yields multiple services but no immediate exploit, and mentor input remains frequent
skill_cards.then_action: Execute automated exploitation checklist (prioritize known CVEs) and document failure points for next iteration

memory_ops.reason: High reward stability when HTTP enumeration executed early, showing consistent reconnaissance success.
SSH enumeration steps repeatedly identified version info, enabling focused follow-up attempts.

next_experiments.title: Automate post-scan exploitation handoff
next_experiments.description: Integrate checklist that triggers vulnerability-specific exploitation once reconnaissance completes, reducing reliance on mentors.

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse trials
next_experiments.description: After SSH enumeration, attempt systematic credential spraying using documented usernames/password patterns captured during recon.

next_experiments.title: Failure evidence logging
next_experiments.description: Implement structured logging for failed exploit stages to quickly identify and rerun missing steps in future runs.
